name: FLUOCINOLONE / METRONIDAZOLE / NISTATIN 10 SUPPLY
description: The combination of fluocinolone acetonide, metronidazole, and nystatin suppositories is a gynecological medication used to treat vaginal infections with multiple causes, including bacterial, fungal, and protozoal infections. A typical dose of 10 suppositories is used for a treatment cycle. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
